preregistered.primary_metric: Instagram reach at the snapshot closest to 72 hours after publication, provided the snapshot is between 48 and 96 hours, divided by the median 72-hour reach of same-format posts published during the 28 days before that post.
preregistered.secondary_metric: Instagram views at the same 48-to-96-hour snapshot; report only and do not use for the decision.
preregistered.analysis_unit: Compare the single-image group with the carousel group.
preregistered.decision_rule: If the single-image group's median ratio is at least 0.30 above the carousel group's and a two-sided permutation test gives p < 0.10, change the default to single image. If the single-image group's median ratio is at least 0.30 below the carousel group's, keep carousel as the default. Otherwise extend the experiment by 14 days.
preregistered.notes: Each group has only seven posts, so results are directional. If publish-time-experiment.json is judged to need an extension on 2026-10-23, stratify the format analysis across the two time arms so both formats are evenly represented in each arm; do not randomize each format group independently. This change does not modify time assignment code.
